lines.3: Miss Inori was making herself at home as though the place belonged to her.
lines.4: 「Why is my darling Miss Inori here?」
lines.5: 「Quite the bold claim to slip in so casually.」
lines.6: 「Unless work requires it, I would rather not even speak to someone like you, Fukahire. My apologies.」
lines.8: 「Hey, love can blossom from beginnings like this.」
lines.9: The guy was nothing if not persistent.
lines.10: 「Miss Inori is the student council executive committee's adviser.」
lines.12: 「Though I am your adviser, I will not interfere in how you run things. I respect the students' independence and leave everything in your hands.」
lines.13: Miss Inori said all this while lounging around.
lines.14: In other words, wasn't she simply washing her hands of the whole thing?
lines.15: Well, it was far better than having someone constantly nag us.
lines.18: 「Well, it is only the first day. Maybe I was getting ahead of myself.」
